name: The Royal Theater
introDiscord:
A royal theater hides behind the palace halls.

Painted scenery, costume racks, orchestra balconies, and a stage framed
by a giant fake crown remain almost intact.

the-usurpers-passage-approach.prompt: The Royal Theater opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message: A prop chest contains Star Candies among fake jewelry.

right.message:
An Usurper's Bladefish bursts through a painted castle backdrop.

Audience participation begins.

forward.message:
Shizuki's bottle sits beside a script:

'Assigned myself lead role.

Glimmer assigned tree.

Glimmer walked off production.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

the-usurpers-passage-depths.prompt: Deeper within The Royal Theater, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message: A Bladefish darts through the orchestra pit.

right.message: A costume trunk contains Star Candies.

forward.message:
One Berry rests beneath a five-star theater review:

'★★★★★

Performance excellent.

Actor was me.

Review unbiased.'
